Hi Anika — thanks for the heads up and for the attachments. I pulled the invite token and it looks valid on our side. A few quick asks so we can narrow down the root cause:

- Could you send a screenshot of the blank page / spinner and, if possible, the browser console error?
- When you tried incognito, did you also disable extensions? Sometimes adblockers interfere with our redirect flow.
- If your IT team runs a proxy that shortens or rewrites query strings, that can truncate RelayState in SAML flows and cause the portal to land on an invalid state.

Workarounds to try right away:
1) Open the invite link in an incognito window with extensions disabled.
2) If that fails, try the “direct vendor portal” link (below) and use the email address we invited — I can push a one-time sign-in token for that route.

Quick technical summary from the SSO logs I pulled:
- The SAML assertion is issuing correctly and our IdP is returning a RelayState of ~420 characters (we use it to rehydrate the invite flow).
- We see several desktop requests where the incoming URL has been shortened (query truncated) before reaching our gateway — likely a proxy or URL-normalization appliance on the customer side. When RelayState is truncated, the portal can't find the pending invite session and falls into a blank spinner while waiting for a session token that never arrives.
- Also noticed a handful of desktop failures where SameSite=None cookies were being blocked by the browser because they arrived without Secure or were set behind an intermediate rewrite. Mobile Safari (iOS) treats some cookies differently, which explains why mobile succeeded.

Immediate recommendations:
- Ask Horizon IT to try the invite in an incognito window with extensions off and also temporarily disable any URL-rewriting proxy for that request.
- Use the alternate invite URL with &skip_relay=1 we provided — that will bypass the RelayState rehydration and fall back to an email-based lookup. I can generate a 2-hour token for that route if you want.
- If Horizon can capture the browser console network trace (HAR) for the failed desktop flow and share the first failed redirect response, we can confirm whether a middlebox is rewriting the query string.

If the workaround works we can mark onboarding complete and confirm PO visibility. If not, I can escalate to our infra team and open a short-lived diagnostic session to replay the IdP flow with Horizon's IT.
